vocabulary_focus.concept: Can I help you? / What can I do?

expressions.en: Can I help you? / What can I do?
expressions.cn: 我可以帮你吗？/ 有什么我可以做的吗？

work.scenario: You're in a virtual team meeting. Your manager introduces a new project. You need to confirm understanding and politely offer help to a new team member who looks confused.

life.scenario: You're at a busy kopitiam during breakfast. You accidentally bump into someone, then need to ask the waiter to wait while you decide your order, and finally thank them for the food.

tech.scenario: Your friend is having trouble setting up a new app on their phone. You offer to help, confirm you understand the issue, and ask them to wait while you troubleshoot.
